name: Minecraft: Fabric
description: Modded Minecraft with the Fabric loader. Drop your mods into the mods/ folder from the file manager.

variables.name: LOADER_VERSION
variables.label: Fabric loader version
variables.description: Fabric loader build. The newest stable one is picked for you.

install.label: Install the Fabric server launcher
install.run:
VER="{{MC_VERSION}}"
if [ "$VER" = "latest" ] || [ -z "$VER" ]; then
  VER=$(curl -sf https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const s=j.find(v=>v.stable);console.log(s?s.version:"");})')
fi
[ -n "$VER" ] || gp_die "Could not resolve a Minecraft version for Fabric"
LOADER="{{LOADER_VERSION}}"
if [ "$LOADER" = "latest" ] || [ -z "$LOADER" ]; then
  LOADER=$(curl -sf https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log(((j.find(x=>x.stable))||j[0]).version);})')
fi
INSTALLER=$(curl -sf https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log(((j.find(x=>x.stable))||j[0]).version);})')
gp_log "Minecraft $VER · Fabric loader $LOADER · installer $INSTALLER"
gp_fetch "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/$VER/$LOADER/$INSTALLER/server/jar" server.jar
mkdir -p mods

install.content:
# Accepted through GamePanel on install
eula=true
